summary: Give each seat a private session inventory for an authored pi or omp transcript

compatibility.detail: On the next authored-transcript start, replace the legacy shared-directory link atomically with a private directory containing only the transcript link and its own artifact directory link. Prepare the original companion directory before linking so the harness can create artifacts through the managed path. Later starts repair missing links and missing companion targets without replacing inventory contents. Original transcripts and other sessions stay in place. Native seed receipts and refusal re-arming are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption or service lifecycle change.

recovery.detail: Migration does not delete or move original transcripts or artifact directories.
